faqs.q: Sec. 18-192. - I.R.C. Section R501.3.1, Structural floors ventilation.
faqs.a:
Section R501.3. Structural floors ventilation,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
R501.3.1. Structural floor ventilation.
Adequate under floor ventilation systems shall be provided to ventilate under floor
                  areas when structural floor systems are required. Such systems shall be designed to
                  provide at least one air change per hour, be controlled by a dehumidistat, and exhaust
                  to the outside. A state licensed engineer's design may be required.
Exception: The building official may approve alternates to such ventilation requirements
                  when sufficient documentation is provided by the engineer of record to substantiate
                  his alternate method is at least the equivalent of that prescribed."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
